criteria.requirement: The offered cloud service contract guarantees at least 99.9% uptime per month.
The offered service includes backups at least every 24 hours.
The offered service commits to AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2 or newer in transit.
The offered service includes human technical support 24 hours per day, seven days per week.
The total offered recurring monthly cost for the requested service, including all mandatory charges, is no more than 500 USD.
